overview.title: A more selective agency model inside the group.
overview.intro: Based in Erlenbach, The Wearhouse Fashion Trade GmbH operates as an independent fashion agency within the Bollag-Guggenheim context. Its proposition is built around elevated fashion labels, close market attention, and a more selective showroom perspective aimed at the Swiss market.
overview.focus: The agency positions itself around curated premium casual Brands and continuing to search for differentiated niche products and new discoveries.
